_doc: Stream E (M2). Wayside dressing: tiny sites with no encounter — a cairn, a milestone, a ribboned tree — that the placer drops into the emptiest stretches so no walk goes more than 250 m without something to notice (PLAN §16 'longest boring walk'). Placement type `wayside` with `id` = one of these ids + a suffix and `kind` = the id here. Props are drawn exactly like a vignette's (same kit ids, offsets rotated by yaw with vignettePoint). `lore` is shown when you walk within `radius` (optional). `biomes` = where it fits best (any if none fit).

kinds.name: Cairn
kinds.lore: Somebody stacked these stones. Everyone who passes adds one. You add one.

kinds.name: Milestone
kinds.lore: A worn stone with a number on it. The number has been argued about for a hundred years.

kinds.name: Ribbon Tree
kinds.lore: Every branch has a ribbon tied to it. Wishes, mostly. One just says 'more cheese'.

kinds.name: Cold Campfire
kinds.lore: A ring of stones, old ash, and a spoon nobody came back for.

kinds.name: Broken Wheel
kinds.lore: A cart wheel, split in two. The rest of the cart got where it was going. Probably.

kinds.name: Old Bones
kinds.lore: Something big died here a long time ago. Something bigger ate it.

kinds.name: Standing Stone
kinds.lore: One tall stone, leaning. It has been leaning for so long it may be doing it on purpose.

kinds.name: Mushroom Ring
kinds.lore: A perfect ring of mushrooms. The old stories say don't step inside. The old stories are very bossy.

kinds.name: Fallen Pillar
kinds.lore: A carved pillar lying in the grass, miles from anything it could have held up.

kinds.name: Lost Signpost
kinds.lore: A signpost with every arm snapped off. It points nowhere, firmly.

kinds.name: Hunter's Rack
kinds.lore: An empty drying rack and a stump to sit on. The hunter will be back. Or won't.

kinds.name: Dolmen
kinds.lore: Three stones and a lid. Old as the hills, and the hills are not saying.

kinds.name: Boundary Stakes
kinds.lore: A line of stakes marking somebody's land. Somebody very sure of themselves.

kinds.name: Wind Shrine
kinds.lore: A little arch of stones the wind sings through. Leave a pebble; take a tune.
